lines.say: This rich asshole staged his own funeral while still alive.
Timothy Dexter, Massachusetts. He got rich buying old war money everybody thought was worthless.
Legend says his rivals told him to ship bed warmers to the Caribbean. The fucking Caribbean.
His captain sold them as molasses ladles, and the lucky bastard cashed in.
Next, they say he shipped coal to a coal town, hit a miners' strike, and got paid again.
He wrote a book with zero punctuation. The second edition added a whole damn page of it.
He put up a statue of himself that called him the greatest philosopher in the Western World.
Then came the funeral. About three thousand people showed up, and the son of a bitch was fine.
caps: and the son of a bitch

lines.say: The man had to play dead to learn who gave a shit. It's Small Business Saturday. No casket needed.
caps: to learn who gave a shit.
